# durantic_vip (Resource)

VIP (Virtual IP) resource for Durantic network load balancing

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Minimal example — only required fields, all defaults apply
resource "durantic_vip" "minimal" {
  name    = "web-vip"
  address = "203.0.113.10"
}

# Full example with all optional fields configured
resource "durantic_vip" "example" {
  name    = "prod-vip"
  enabled = true
  address = "203.0.113.10"

  health_check_type                = "http"
  health_check_target              = "/healthz"
  health_check_interval_seconds    = 10
  health_check_timeout_seconds     = 5
  health_check_healthy_threshold   = 2
  health_check_unhealthy_threshold = 3
  health_check_holdoff_seconds     = 30

  machine_uuids = [
    "a8ecf9c8-1721-424d-ba0f-87917dfc03d8",
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `address` (String) IP address for the VIP
- `name` (String) Name of the VIP

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the VIP is enabled
- `health_check_healthy_threshold` (Number) Number of consecutive successes required to mark as healthy
- `health_check_holdoff_seconds` (Number) Seconds to wait after creation before starting health checks
- `health_check_interval_seconds` (Number) Interval in seconds between health checks
- `health_check_target` (String) Health check target (path or command depending on type)
- `health_check_timeout_seconds` (Number) Timeout in seconds for each health check
- `health_check_type` (String) Health check type. Valid values: `""` (disabled), `tcp`, `http`, `https`, `grpc`, `grpcs`, `exec`
- `health_check_unhealthy_threshold` (Number) Number of consecutive failures required to mark as unhealthy
- `machine_uuids` (List of String) UUIDs of machines to associate with this VIP

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the VIP was created
- `machine_count` (Number) Number of machines associated with this VIP
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the VIP was last updated
- `uuid` (String) Unique identifier for the VIP

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import durantic_vip.example "a8ecf9c8-1721-424d-ba0f-87917dfc03d8"
```
